paper_title: Federated Learning-Enabled Hybrid Language Models for   Communication-Efficient Token Transmission
caption: Token Resolution Breakdown for FedHLM: Local, P2P, and LLM Token Distribution.
model_annotation: This pie chart represents the distribution of token routing within a FedHLM system. The chart displays four slices, labeled LOCAL, EDGE_P2P, LLM, and LLM. The largest slice, colored green and representing LOCAL, occupies approximately 94.5% of the total area. The second largest slice, colored red, labeled EDGE_P2P, represents approximately 1.6% of the total. A smaller slice, colored blue, labeled LLM, accounts for around 3.9% of the total. The chart includes percentage labels within each slice. There is no legend or visual emphasis on any of the slices. The slices appear ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their area within the pie chart.
